tools.name: get_mineral_prices
tools.description: Fetch normalized real-time spot prices, bid/ask spreads, and multi-unit conversions for critical physical commodities: Silver (Ag), Platinum (Pt), Copper (Cu), Lithium (Li), and Neodymium/Dysprosium (NdDy). Requires 0.005 USDC payment on Base network via x402.

tools.name: get_arbitrage_spreads
tools.description: Calculate cross-exchange price spreads and locational arbitrage opportunities between COMEX, LME, SMM, and LPPM benchmarks, factoring in estimated freight and tariffs. Requires 0.005 USDC payment on Base network via x402.

tools.name: calculate_urban_mining_value
tools.description: Evaluate contained minerals, process recovery efficiencies, and net payable batch value after refining/treatment charges (TC/RC) for urban mining scrap feedstocks (EV Battery Black Mass, Auto Catalysts, E-Waste PCBs, Rare Earth Magnets). Requires 0.005 USDC payment on Base network via x402.

quantity_metric_tons.description: Total batch weight in metric tons

custom_assay_overrides.description: Optional custom assay grades to override standard defaults (e.g. {'Li': 4.2} in % or {'Pt': 2100} in ppm)

refining_cost_per_ton_usd.description: Optional custom refining & treatment charge per ton in USD

recovery_efficiency_factor.description: Recovery efficiency multiplier (1.0 = standard benchmark recovery)
